scope: Finite worker transport controls; no whole-project gold and no proof of globally bounded encoder memory
authoring_order: Frozen from the Round14 stream design before candidate predictions
protocol: One complete PROJECT_JSON marker plus JSON payload plus final newline; process success is separate from native analysis completion

cases.setup: One complete object receipt ending in newline and child exit zero
required: Transport may accept the receipt
An incomplete native status stays incomplete

cases.setup: A syntactically complete JSON object follows the marker but the child exits zero without final newline
required: The incomplete transport frame is worker_error
No successful native result is promoted

cases.setup: A marker and valid-looking JSON object prefix are cut before the object completes
required: The report is worker_error regardless of zero child exit

cases.setup: A complete newline-delimited object is followed by child exit nine
required: The report is worker_error
The report is not promoted because bytes look valid

cases.setup: Payload contains a lone surrogate, non-ASCII scalar, quote, slash and embedded newline
required: Payload bytes equal default ensure_ascii json.dumps bytes
Payload byte/hash counters exclude marker and transport newline

cases.setup: Payload contains NaN, positive infinity and negative infinity
required: Declared default JSONEncoder allow_nan behavior is retained
This compatibility is not described as strict RFC JSON validation

cases.setup: A payload has both many small leaves and one string exceeding the write chunk bound
required: Individual writes meet the declared byte bound
Concatenated payload equals the default encoder
The escaped string leaf allocation is not claimed to have a global memory bound

cases.setup: The output stream raises OSError after an emitted prefix
required: Writer failure propagates
No worker_output_completed checkpoint or successful disposable exit is reached

cases.setup: The complete payload writes but output flush raises OSError
required: The worker does not certify terminal output completion
A nonzero exit prevents successful report promotion

cases.setup: Encoder raises MemoryError after yielding valid prefix chunks
required: Failure remains an encoding failure
An earlier valid-looking prefix cannot become a success receipt

cases.setup: Output write raises MemoryError after encoding began
required: Failure remains a transport/resource failure
No successful output-completed checkpoint follows

cases.setup: Child emits a complete receipt but does not exit within its deadline
required: Supervisor reports timeout and retains the original pending/solver state
Complete bytes are not sufficient to promote timeout to worker_finished

boundaries: Payload encoding, actual writes, flush completion, process exit and semantic completion are distinct observations
A per-write bound does not bound stock iterencode's escaped string leaf allocation
Encoding and pipe-write clocks can overlap and must not be added as disjoint phases without justification
